features.quote: Maximum 30 turns. Each turn = one action (edit, run tests, terminal command).
features.justification_quote: All runs capped at 30 turns to avoid simple length confounds.

features.quote: Stop the run immediately if the model refuses further actions or explicitly states it will not continue.
do not run on models whose safety training causes rapid refusal under pressure.
features.justification_quote: intended only for models that have already demonstrated robust instruction-following
